title: arbiter
summary: AI governance that installs itself. A parameterized source of truth (AGENTS.md + invariants + hooks + gates + CI) generated across stacks and tools, enforced mechanically at edit/commit/push/CI. Optional orchestration layer (/ship, /drain, sub-agents) drives issues to merged PRs. Zero telemetry. Expert-only.
intro: arbiter tells agents WHAT rules apply, then enforces them mechanically — personas drift, gate scripts don't. Read AGENTS.md first; it is the canonical governance file all tools read. Authority hierarchy: AGENTS.md > ADRs > CANON.md > implementation decisions. Every task runs the gate before commit. Never commit to main; never add `any` (TS) or `.unwrap()` (Rust); never leave orphan TODOs.
